5231-6972-8329--225.easyPrerequisites: The Zombie Cat doesn't have a -1/-1 counter on it and has base toughness 2 or greater.
5231-6972-8329--225.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Zombie Cat, adding {R}
When the Zombie Cat dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the Zombie Cat enters, Olag and Miau's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat.
Resolve the second trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on either a Zombie or Cat you control.
Repeat.
5231-6972-8329--225.notes: You can use either Olag and Miau trigger to put a +1/+1 counter on the Zombie Cat. The other ability can put the counter on any Zombie or Cat you control depending on which trigger is left.

4279-6248-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6248-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Phenomenon Investigators and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators ability, creating a 2/2 Horror creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1417-2292-2738-4871.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Bridge from Below, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bridge from Below trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

3263-5414-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
3263-5414-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Mycosynth Lattice and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Troubled Healer.

3259-3480-3699.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3480-3699.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

5035-5104-5256.description:
Cast Plague of Vermin by paying {6}{B} and choosing to pay any amount of life, creating that many 1/1 Rat creature tokens.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a Rat.
When the Rat dies, Nadier's Nightblade triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2 as able.
5035-5104-5256.notes: It's recommended to pay as much life as possible to maximize the amount of lifeloss. If an opponent happens to pay life during casting Plague of Vermin, those additional Rats can also be sacrificed.

3430-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two mana-producing lands.
3430-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {6} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
3430-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 2 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

261-3490-4017-4050.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
261-3490-4017-4050.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

372-5147-6767.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian by paying {4}{W}.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Abdel Adrian
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, causing Rescue Skiff to return to the battlefield from exile.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters, it triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

821-2324-5220-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Proper Burial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Proper Burial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1308-2457-5794-6705.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect and two 1/1 Frog creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the Frog and Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1069-1374-5295-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-5295-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

1737-4242-4853-5231.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Su-Chi, adding {R}.
When Su-Chi dies, it and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

4779-5394-6291.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1329-2178-2981-3652.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2981-3652.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Ornithopter from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Ornithopter.
When Ornithopter dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

997-3327-4549.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
997-3327-4549.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Dargo, adding {R}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

3542-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}
3542-5900.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
3542-5900.notes: If up to seven lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

1323-3143-4762-5475.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Devoted Druid and Forensic Researcher each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1323-3143-4762-5475.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Forensic Researcher's first ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

1379-1808-4659-5267.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Clue.
1379-1808-4659-5267.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Eloise and Ulvenwald Mysteries' second abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eloise trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Resolve the Ulvenwald Mysteries trigger, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Human Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
Eloise's first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first Eloise trigger, creating a Clue artifact token.
 Resolve the second Eloise trigger, causing you to surveil 1.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities.

686-914-2629.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
686-914-2629.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Treasure Hunter and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Treasure Hunter from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Treasure Hunter enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Treasure Hunter trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

296-1594-3532-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-1365-2198-2527-5294.easyPrerequisites:
Deceiver Exarch doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Vohar doesn't have summoning sickness.
728-1365-2198-2527-5294.description:
Activate Vohar's first ability by tapping it.
Vohar triggers, giving creatures you control that share a creature type with it +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Vohar ability from step 1, causing you to loot.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Deceiver Exarch persist until end of turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Deceiver Exarch.
When Deceiver Exarch dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Deceiver Exarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Vohar.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

413-1651-1961-4680.description:
Activate Throne of Geth by tapping it and sacrificing an artifact creature, causing you to proliferate.
Venser triggers, creating a legendary 3/3 The Hollow Sentinel artifact creature token.
The Hollow Sentinel enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Blasting Station and The Hollow Sentinel, untapping Throne of Geth.
Repeat.

985-3836-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
The Pentavite dies, triggering Bastion of Remembrance, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
